summary: The control now remains visible and enabled when saved selections are missing from an empty catalog, and the added focused test verifies the visibility contract.

evidence: static/admin.js now hides the control only when modelsMissingIds() is empty, so saved ids remain actionable when the catalog is empty.
The existing click handler removes missing ids and rerenders the picker, leaving the selection unsaved so it can be saved as an empty filter.
tests/admin-models-catalog.test.ts adds a focused assertion covering the Remove-missing visibility condition.
